ledger: Center wooden door | Located behind the man; has a blue coat and round brass ornament on its left panel, and a bare wooden right panel behind the man's head | At 00:08, after the man steps left, the right panel immediately adjacent to the blue coat now contains a framed picture | Layout changes when uncovered by the man's movement

Wall strip with switch plate and right door | Located to the right of the center door frame, separating the center door from the framed picture on the far right (00:00-00:07) | Disappears at 00:08 as the framed picture shifts onto the center door panel next to the blue coat | Spatial layout between the coat and framed picture collapses

Left perpendicular wooden door | Partially visible on the far left edge forming an inside corner (00:00-00:07) | Fully revealed on the left with a brass knob and adjacent wall switches as the camera pans left (00:08-00:09) | Consistent camera pan reveal on the left side

findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, the wooden door panel immediately to the right of the hanging blue coat (visible behind the man's head) is bare wood, followed to the right by a door frame, a strip of wall with a switch box, and another door containing a framed picture. When the man steps left at 00:08, the intermediate door frame and wall strip with the switch box vanish, and a framed picture now appears directly on the wooden panel immediately to the right of the blue coat.
